title: Memory access and thread mapping: matrix transpose

steps.title: Naive transpose: one thread per element
More loads in flight: 32×2 threads per tile

cases.name: tiny
cases.purpose: Smaller than one tile: checks row/column indices and bounds checks. Each value equals its linear address in the input, so a wrong value shows where it came from.

cases.name: tail
cases.purpose: One more than a multiple of 32 in both directions: checks the tail tiles.

cases.name: row
cases.purpose: Degenerates to one row: the transpose is one column, which tells a transpose apart from a copy.

cases.name: tall
cases.purpose: Tall, thin matrix: grid coverage in both directions.

cases.name: big
cases.purpose: 256 MB input, far larger than the 126 MB L2: measures HBM bandwidth utilization.
